purpose: Determine whether the graph-only compiler setting captures and replays representative forward/backward regions on the corrected exact target path.
authorization_gate: Root explicitly released the exclusive eight-GPU lease for this single attempt. The attempt is complete; no further Lane A launch is authorized by this handoff.

source_snapshot.identity_rule: Use the source manifest's per-file SHA-256 values plus archive hash. The tracked-patch digest alone is not the source freeze gate because task source files include untracked files.

preserved_target_settings: local batch 8, global batch 256, sequence length 4096

graph_policy.only_compiler_option_change: TORCHINDUCTOR_CUDAGRAPHS=1; fresh-process GRAPH-OPTION/001 showed the corresponding config change is only triton.cudagraphs false to true.

prerequisite.all_eight_rank_logs: native/structured_logs/training.global_rank_0..7.*.jsonl each contain step_end 1..25, 100 fwd_bwd_end records, and 25 optim_end records.
prerequisite.limitation: Corrected graph-off smoke only; not stable/noise, capture, numerical parity, or performance evidence.

outcome_policy: On a graph capture error, stop and preserve the first rank-local failure and preceding cudagraph log context; do not retry with changed options.
Capture/recording log entries do not count as replay. Confirm actual graph launches in representative all-rank CUDA traces and correlate their timing with native fwd_bwd and optim spans.
No graph launches means no demonstrated replay, even if capture logs exist.
Passing this attempt establishes diagnostic capture/replay coverage only, not numerical correctness or speedup.
